assumption: This is a cost-threshold assessment. No SBSP result is expressed as a deployment-year forecast.
limitation: Official UK benchmarks may contain source publication years or commissioning references, but they are not used as SBSP scenarios.

assumption: All model financial inputs and outputs are interpreted in 2024 real GBP and LCOE is reported in GBP/MWh at the grid connection point.
limitation: Some external benchmarks use different real-price bases; these are labelled rather than silently harmonised.

assumption: End-to-end efficiency is applied by increasing required space-side power capacity for a fixed delivered-grid capacity.
limitation: This simplifies subsystem losses into one continuous variable.

assumption: Specific mass is applied per kW of required space-side power capacity.
limitation: Architecture-specific mass allocation between arrays, structures and transmitters is not modelled.

assumption: Programme margin is applied to all pre-margin CAPEX categories.
limitation: The model does not separately estimate owner costs, insurance during construction or first-of-a-kind programme development.

assumption: Replacement and refurbishment are modelled as an annual allowance based on initial CAPEX.
limitation: Periodic major replacement timing is not explicitly optimised.

assumption: Renewable system-adjusted benchmarks use BEIS enhanced LCOE ranges from 2020 because the latest DESNZ 2025 LCOE report says wider system costs require full system modelling.
limitation: Values are in 2018 real GBP and should be treated as indicative ranges.

assumption: Nuclear is represented only by a public contract-price marker because recent DESNZ reports do not publish an updated generic nuclear LCOE.
limitation: Not directly comparable with 2024 real generation LCOE.

assumption: A threshold is necessary only within this model, its accounting boundary and the stated parameter ranges; it is not a universal engineering requirement.
limitation: Alternative architectures, coupled parameter changes or omitted system value can move the threshold.

assumption: Published SBSP cost estimates are used as context and consistency checks, not as validation or direct substitutes for this model's inputs.
limitation: Architectures, orbit destinations, price years, financing and cost boundaries differ materially across studies.

assumption: The parameter named wacc is implemented as a real project discount-rate proxy in the capital-recovery factor; taxes, inflation and financing tranches are not modelled.
limitation: It should not be read as a fully specified observed pre-tax or post-tax corporate WACC.

assumption: The model ends at the grid connection point and uses a delivered capacity-factor proxy that combines availability, outages and operating constraints.
limitation: Downstream transmission reinforcement, balancing, storage, reliability services, curtailment and monetised system value are excluded.
